text: つかうのは　いわ　タイプ　ばっかりだ！

structure.jp: いわ　タイプ　ばっかりだ！

patterns.name: 〜の (nominalizer)
patterns.explanation: の turns a verb into a thing: 'the one that...'. つかうのは = 'what I use'.

patterns.name: 〜ばかり
patterns.explanation: ばっかり is a casual ばかり, meaning 'nothing but'. いわタイプばっかりだ = 'it's nothing but Rock types'.
